finding.statement: Let C^n be the n-fold fibre product of the closed universal curve over M_g, with Leray-Kunneth summands indexed by multi-indices i in {0,1,2}^n of total fibre degree |i|. At (g,n,k)=(6,6,26), Harer vanishing H^p(M_6;L)=0 for every rational local system L and every p>19 kills every summand with |i|<=6, since those have base degree 26-|i|>=20. Every remaining summand has |i|>=7 and base degree <=19, so it is not killed by vcd(M_6). Each such summand has some slot of value 2, but that does not place the summand in the image of cup-product with a psi class: the class omega_s, and its restriction psi_s, is Kunneth-inhomogeneous, and fibre restriction does not isolate the slot-2 component. Absent a projector, Morita vanishing of the slot-1 component, or a downward induction on |i|, the surviving |i|>=7 summands form an uncontrolled complement in W_26 H^26(C^6) and therefore in its image W_26 H^26(M_{6,6};Q). CKgP at M_{6,5} types only the psi-generated subspace and does not exhaust this complement. The argument exhibits no surviving non-Tate summand, so the exact target is incomplete rather than refuted.
